title: plugin-chatbot: "Save question" and "Save as view / report draft" actions on an answer, calling the saved-question and answer-artifact routes cloud ships
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ② a class (a) out-of-scope finding from a cloud card's os-dev-report: cloud#4097 report 6736901731. The cloud consumer is PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4107, Ask saved questions and answer → view or report draft (cloud#3825 item 9).

Dedupe: objectstack#31865 is the thumbs rating, and objectstack#31868 renders the `source` block. Neither adds save actions.

Suggested grade: p3. Reader: a `domain:ui` seat.

## Problem

Cloud now answers these routes:
- `POST|GET|DELETE /api/v1/ai/saved-questions`;
- `POST /api/v1/ai/saved-questions/:id/run`;
- `POST /api/v1/ai/conversations/:id/turns/:turnId/artifact` with `kind: view | report | widget`.

A member has no way to reach them from the chat. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:4831-4862` (MessageActions) offers no save action, and the client SDK has no method for these routes.

## What done looks like

1. On an assistant answer whose turn carries a data tool result with a `source`, MessageActions offers:
   - "Save question";
   - "Save as my view";
   - "Save as report draft" and "Add as dashboard widget draft", shown only when the server says the caller may author. Otherwise they are hidden, or show the server's named refusal `report_authoring_requires_manage_metadata`.
2. A "Saved questions" list in the chat side panel: run (shows the fresh result) and delete.
3. Copy in all four locales. Nothing is published from the chat: report and widget results are drafts, and the card says so.
4. Tests:
   - each action calls its route with the turn and tool-call ids;
   - a refusal renders the server's reason;
   - no action shows on a turn without a `source`.

Seam: cloud service-ai saved-question and artifact routes → plugin-chatbot MessageActions and the client SDK.
